basics.name: Vinayak Gupta
basics.label: AI Engineer
basics.opportunities: Open to roles in India and internationally.
basics.summary: AI Engineer building practical agents and AI systems. Initiated an internal code reviewer now in active team use; lead DevOps for a multi-agent platform in UAT. Earlier at Tiger Analytics, delivered RAG and data workflows while working directly with client teams.

highlights: Initiated and built an internal AI code reviewer to address the team's review bottleneck. In active team use since July 2026, it reviews approximately 30-40 PRs per month across 5-6 repositories. The webhook-triggered pipeline enriches diffs with acceptance criteria and file context, separates read-only review from publishing, and reconciles comments idempotently. Iterated on fixes from team feedback after launch.

Contributed to a multi-agent orchestration system in UAT since March 2026 (Microsoft Agent Framework, .NET, Azure OpenAI), including planning, an MCP gateway for internal APIs, and evaluation regression gates. Five agents have been onboarded through the open Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol.

Led DevOps for the orchestrator, owning Bicep-provisioned Azure Container Apps, Cosmos DB, Key Vault, and multi-environment, approval-gated Azure DevOps CI/CD. Delivered secure infrastructure designed for high availability through Azure Front Door, Application Gateway (WAF), and VNets, alongside end-to-end Azure AD B2C identity propagation, per-tenant isolation, and cross-service OpenTelemetry tracing.
Member of the AI Center of Excellence; tasked as an advisor to 10+ participating teams in an internal AI hackathon, guiding their solutions on cloud infrastructure and AI/ML design decisions.

Delivered a Python-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) application with a custom document index for a mobile payments service, improving retrieval accuracy by 20% and lowering response time by 60% through API load balancing and efficient prompt flow design.

Established a company-wide, Git-based LLMOps workflow in Azure ML SDK for prompt flow experimentation and evaluation, simplifying deployment across Docker images, Kubernetes clusters, and Azure ML endpoints.

Enhanced a product portfolio management platform for a global FMCG client by designing automated data ingestion and preprocessing pipelines that integrated high-volume data into SQL databases using Azure Data Factory and SQL-based transformations to deliver application-ready data models.

Built end-to-end analytics solutions using automated Databricks pipelines and Power BI dashboards with scheduled refresh and KPI computation, improving the reliability and repeatability of business reporting workflows.

Migrated the codebase and its CI/CD pipelines from Azure DevOps to GitHub Actions, implementing infrastructure-as-code, versioning, and quality checks to strengthen deployment consistency and engineering standards.
